title: Extract a runnable JAR and both library scopes from an executable WAR
summary: Extracts an actual packaged executable, reads the relocated web resources and dependency bytes, then launches its application JAR from a separate directory.

subject.symbol: Repackager.repackage → tools extraction and extracted java -jar

change.description: The packagers can record a second library root in `Spring-Boot-Lib-Provided`. The tools jarmode uses both roots to translate the WAR’s classpath index into the extracted application JAR’s class path.
